name: Usability Test Responses
description_text:
While conducting your studies, document as much as you can the user's input. 

I have compiled important tips for you to reference when observing users as you conduct your tests: What to look for in a usability study

Once completed, post your gathered research data here. Your Spreadsheet(s) are made up of:

Interview Responses

Survey data

The due date is only a reference for your timing of the workload. If you need more time, you will not be marked down if you submit this assignment the final week of class. 

Samples found here:

World Vision Interview Notes.xls

playnetwork_findings_spreadsheet.xlsx

Tanooki Research Data (To download as an xls, go to the Files tab)
